data.title: Search the journal on each prompt through a Claude Code hook, offered once per session and never gated on coverage
data.why: Restates DEC-33, which DEC-35 superseded by mistake: the hook itself still stands, only its installation changed. Agents told to search did not (1 in 10, then 0 in 10 after the instruction files said 'before grep'); with the hook's lines next to the same prompt 9 in 10 used the journal, 10 of 10 were right, median context 7.9k tokens against 10.9k (KAD-53). A coverage gate was measured and rejected (KAD-56): at 0.7 the hook fell silent on 72 of 75 questions the journal answers and still spoke on 5 of 30 code prompts, because short coding prompts carry more of their words into the journal than paraphrased questions do. Instead the lines are offered on a condition, a record is shown once per session (state in the system temp directory, never .kadence/), and on ten ordinary code tasks the cost was ~180 tokens with no agent sent into the journal.
data.rejected: Instruction text alone: measured, it did not change the first move; A coverage gate on whether to speak at all: silences the questions it exists for; A PreToolUse hook on grep: fires on legitimate code searches, after the tokens are spent; Quoting a passage for every hit: a confidently wrong passage makes a model fabricate more than none (DEC-30)
